description: This file defines interfaces related to warning reporting within the WPEFramework project. It declares external warning event and reporting unit interfaces, as well as nested control interfaces for managing warning categories and configurations.

classes.name: IWarningEvent
classes.description: Interface for warning events, supporting serialization, deserialization, categorization, and representation as a string.

classes.name: IWarningReportingUnit
classes.description: Interface for managing warning reporting units, including reporting warning events and managing categories.

classes.name: IWarningReportingUnit::IWarningReportingControl
classes.description: Nested interface for controlling warning reporting categories, including exclusion, configuration, and cloning.

methods.name: ReportWarningEvent
methods.description: Logs or reports a warning event identified by an identifier string.

methods.name: FetchCategoryInformation
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific warning category.

methods.name: AddToCategoryList
methods.description: Adds a warning category control to the category list.

methods.name: RemoveFromCategoryList
methods.description: Removes a warning category control from the category list.

methods.name: Exclude
methods.description: Excludes a warning category from reporting or processing.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures a warning category with specific settings.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the warning reporting control.
